name: RegExr
tagline: The pattern and the test text live in this file — works on a plane, one Invite shares it.
description:
No account, no tab to lose. Type a pattern, see matches light up in the text as you type, and close the app — they are still here next time, because the pattern lives in this file. Press Invite in the bar above and a friend is on the same expression with you. regexr.com cannot do that offline.

Cheatsheet and the full Reference sit beside the editor; click a token to insert it. Tools: Replace, List, Details (capture groups), Explain. Tests check that the expression matches (or does not). JavaScript RegExp in this tab — nothing is uploaded.

An unofficial port of RegExr by Grant Skinner and gskinner.com. Bugs go to GifOS, not upstream. Community catalog and the PHP/PCRE engine are not in this copy.
